name: youre-all-wrong
description: A local-first, custom-episode party trivia show.

scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:desktop && concurrently -k -n WEB,DESKTOP -c cyan,yellow "npm:dev:web" "npm:dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env YAW_DEV_WEB_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron dist/desktop/main.cjs
scripts.build:server: tsup src/server/standalone.ts --format esm --platform node --target node22 --out-dir dist/server --clean false
scripts.build:desktop: tsup src/desktop/main.ts src/desktop/preload.ts src/desktop/runtime-process.ts --format cjs --platform node --target node22 --out-dir dist/desktop --external electron --clean false
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
